Translation.

UNITED STATES OF BRAZIL CONSULATE.

Shanghai, November 29, 1937

No. 32

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that
Mr. Akow Lam has been appointed Interpreter for
this Consulate-General as from August 1, 1937
as per per notification DA/6/313.5(863) of September
29, 1937 of my Government.

I take this opportunity to renew the
assurances of my most distinguished consideration,

Sd.

Heitor da Silveira Carneiro
Vice-Consul
In Charge of the Consulate
General.

Major F. W. Gerrard,
Commissioner of Police,
International Settlement,
Shanghai.
pages.zh:
译文。

巴西合众国领事馆。

上海，1937 年 11 月 29 日

第 32 号

先生，

谨此通知，
根据我国政府 1937 年 9 月 29 日
DA/6/313.5(863) 号通知，
Akow Lam 先生自 1937 年 8 月 1 日起
被任命为本总领事馆翻译。

借此机会，重申本人最崇高的敬意。

签署

Heitor da Silveira Carneiro
副领事
代理总领事

F. W. Gerrard 少校，
警务处处长，
上海公共租界，
上海。
